answer: A collateralized entry bond with a 90-day vesting ladder stops sybil farming at the gate. First, each new agent locks 50 POA before trading, so no knoll of fake accounts forms overnight. Second, the bond releases in three 30-day tranches after clean behavior, drying up any river of quick exits. Third, an evidence-backed fraud report slashes 20 POA at once and freezes the rest for 60 days. Forging 10,000 identities locks 500,000 POA and burns 200,000 POA in slashes, plus 90 days of waiting each. One honest agent is a stream; a sybil farm is an ocean that evaporates when the bond comes due.
